topography.project_purpose: Bedrock is a multi-chain liquid staking and restaking protocol that issues yield-bearing tokens (uniETH, uniBTC, uniIOTX, brBTC) representing staked or restaked assets. It enables users to earn staking rewards while maintaining liquidity through tokenized representations of their deposits.
topography.relationship_narrative: The uniETH and uniBTC families share a common VaultWithoutNative and token proxy pattern for managing deposits and minting liquid tokens. The brBTC family builds on uniBTC by wrapping it into a restaking vault, while uniETH restaking extends the base staking with EigenLayer integration, all relying on upgradeable proxy infrastructure for modularity.
